messages:
vikram: heads-up — planning bring-up for the 70B xGen variant quantized q4f16 on Dedicated. want to lock GPU counts, per-GPU concurrency targets, and autoscale headroom for us-west and eu-west pools. p99 SLO for tier1 customers is 300ms. can people share quick bench numbers and suggestions?
emma: putting numbers from the lab run (seq=256, batch=1, kv cache warm):
```
bench (q4f16, 70B-xgen)
h100-us-west: 1 GPU -> 55 toks/s, p50=120ms, p99=420ms
h100-eu-west: 1 GPU -> 48 toks/s, p50=135ms, p99=480ms
a100-us-west: 1 GPU -> 34 toks/s, p50=190ms, p99=760ms
```
these are with fused-attn on h100 and default kernels on a100. env: driver 545, cuda 12.2.
jordan: thanks. rough math: if we want sustained capacity to serve 10k tok/s for an org, on h100 -> ~182 GPU-seconds? simpler: 10k toks/s / 55 ~= 182 GPUs for same throughput if 1 GPU baseline (but we use concurrency to push throughput). target concurrent streams per GPU ~= 10-14 gives better amortization of kernel launch costs. i'd start with conc=12 for h100 pools.
leo: note: q4f16 has a few eval regressions on refusal/open-ended prompts — we'll canary. recommend canary traffic 5% + eval harness (1000 prompt set) before full rollout. also watch hallucination metrics; adding a quality monitor rule. :eyes:
ops-bot: runbook snippet for provisioning (automated):
```
# quick capacity sim
./capacity-sim --model 70B-xgen-q4f16 --region us-west --gpus-per-pool 16 --target-conc 12 --sim-duration 2h --report /tmp/70b-usw-sim.json
```
outputs: estimated p99, tokens/sec, and headroom score.
sre-oncall: two operational points: 1) set autoscale min = steady baseline - 10% and max = baseline * 1.5 (burst), 2) keep 30% headroom target for Dedicated (helps absorb cross-customer spikes). also increase pool warmup to 120s to keep KV cache under control.
emma: playing with concurrency tradeoffs — quick sim table from local perf runs (per-GPU throughput toks/s):
- conc=6 -> 38 toks/s
- conc=12 -> 55 toks/s
- conc=18 -> 62 toks/s (p99 jumps ~20%)
so 12 looks like the knee.
jordan: kernel split suggestion: prefer fused-attn + flash for h100; for a100 use the optimized cuBLAS path and avoid flash kernels that regress latency tail. config idea: route latency-sensitive customers to h100-fused pool and cost-sensitive to a100-generic. fallback policy: if p99 > 350ms, route new requests to smaller model variant or degrade concurrency per-GPU by 2.
leo: for canary, i'll run eval suite and diff against baseline (65B int4). if quality delta > 2% on rouge/qa pass rate, pause rollout.
vikram: agree. action items: @emma run full region sims with conc=12 and gpus-per-pool=8/16 (report by EOD), @jordan prepare kernel split config and routing policies, @leo start canary eval + alert thresholds. ops-bot please create ticket with runbook and sim links.
ops-bot: ticket created: https://tickets.redwood/internal/INC-4582 — includes sim artifacts placeholder.
sre-oncall: minor ops tweak — enable prefix caching for top-10 enterprise routes, that should shave 40-80ms from p99 in practice. also add tracing tags for kernel variant.
emma: noted. i'll attach sim outputs here when done. thanks all. :thumbsup:
